description: This file defines the CustomerOption class, which models a customer attribute option in the system. It extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable, containing fields for type, name, default value, and available values, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: A class representing a customer attribute option with type, name, default value, and available values.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the customer option.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the customer option.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the customer option.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the customer option.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the customer option.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the customer option.

methods.name: getAvailableValues
methods.description: Returns the list of available values for the customer option.

methods.name: setAvailableValues
methods.description: Sets the list of available values for the customer option.
